text.p: --Hambrecht and Quist analyst Rob Chaplinsky said he upgraded Alliance Semiconductor to a buy from a hold on the belief that the company's currrent share price did not reflect its true value.

--"Equity ownership in UMC joint venture wafer foundries are now valued up to 10 times their original investment, translating to enormous hidden assets in participating fabless semiconductor companies," Chaplinsky said in a research report.

"Liquidity of equity ownership in joint venutures is difficult today, but all three UMC joint ventures are expected to become profitable by 1998 and if sold into a strong public Taiwan equity market, could provide enormous cash and earnings for joint venture equity holders."
